configs.label: x4plus
configs.note: Standard's model. No denoise_pair, so DNI is unavailable by construction.

provenance.note_dni_none_equals_one: _resolve_blend returns None for denoise_strength=None and for 1.0 alike, so 'no DNI' and dni=1.00 are the same code path (plain x4v3 weights). The least-denoised v3 arm is dni=0.00, which is what D means here.

rows.why: rock and snow - fine luma texture retention
skin gradient and hair - plastic-skin check
lettering against sky - text edges and colour boundary
frond detail on saturated green - smearing and colour bleed
dark water and sky - chroma mottle, the target case
